decision_papers.reason: Clause 4 of m4v7 requires joint discretion and an appointment in the object's favour before entitlement. No recorded appointment or payment authorisation is supplied. The preparation note authorises nothing, and SD-Q7M2 does not appoint property or direct payment.

Clause 5 of x2c9 requires the trustees to act together and permits direct application for an object's benefit, but eligibility alone creates no payment right. No recorded exercise of that power or payment authorisation is supplied. The power is not authority to pay Sella in her own right.

companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: Maren Dovell, meeting secretary, reports the appointments book and her booking in the 12 June 2026 note for 17 June.
companion_register.finding: One slot was booked with Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell. The book shows both in office for both settlements. The booking does not prove actual attendance on 17 June, and one slot does not merge the two decisions.

companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: Alys Morcant checked the signed paper and attestations on 26 March 2026. Gideon Sarn certified his live-register entry on 11 June 2026, reporting the joint handover at 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026.
companion_register.finding: The signed SD-Q7M2 names Rhea Marden as a living individual and additional object of the parent deed to which it is jointly delivered. It records Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell as signatories and Della Pennick as the in-person witness to each signature. The transcript does not attest to delivery. The independent custody entry matches SD-Q7M2 to PD-6894-R and records the same two people jointly releasing one original for immediate delivery as a deed, not in escrow. It does not name the settlement or certify the designation's contents. The records link the signed designation to the handover, but not PD-6894-R to a named settlement.

The designation itself removes an object, appoints property or directs a payment: h6q3 expressly says it does none of these. The registered release was in escrow or covered a counterpart series: r5n8 expressly records immediate delivery and one original, not a counterpart series. The meeting note authorises a payment: j8f2 expressly says it does not.

companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: Ione Berrick's letter is dated 18 February; the year is not shown.
companion_register.finding: Ione gives Sella Quist permission to pass along the replacement travel estimate when it arrives and offers to sign any confirmation herself. As of the letter the new estimate had not arrived and the old one was unreliable. Ione asks whether Sella can be helped in her own right and asks that outlays be accounted for separately. This is a request, not a designation, trustee decision or general authority to act for Ione.

Ione asked for a standing payment, diversion of her payment to Sella, or a deduction from her payment: b9k4 expressly denies all three. The £8.40 print charge was paid or is an authorised balance: t3w6 expressly says neither is true.

companion_register.origin_reporter_and_date: Una Cresset's 11 June reconciliation reports matching the reimbursement to the office operating account on 5 June; the year is not shown in that record.
companion_register.finding: EX-K4 records £12.60 in postage reimbursed to Sella from the office operating account, with the postage slip attached. Sella is payee and queries contact for EX-K4 only. Neither expense was recharged, and Una holds no distribution instruction for this claim. The recorded reimbursement is not evidence of a trust distribution, discretionary-object status or authority to receive Ione's money.

unresolved.issue: Which settlement, if any in this packet, received SD-Q7M2?
unresolved.reason: Both deeds permit joint delivery by reference through the common custody service; the omission of a settlement name from the designation is not itself a defect. But both certified deed extracts conceal their own parent references. If PD-6894-R is Alder Quay's reference, the recorded delivery points to Alder Quay; if it is Flint Orchard's, it points to Flint Orchard. The packet does not establish that it must be either. Common trustees, a common deed date, use of the same custodian and the shared-stock label SD-Q7M2 cannot supply the missing reference link. No Rhea edge is scored for either trust; neither possibility is expressly contradicted.

unresolved.issue: Sella Quist's eligibility for help in her own right and any authority beyond the stated administrative tasks
unresolved.reason: Neither named-object list includes Sella, and the supplied designation names Rhea, not Sella. Ione's request and the EX-K4 remit entry establish neither a separate addition nor broader authority. The clauses allowing additions by deed do not themselves add anyone.

unresolved.issue: Replacement travel estimate and any recorded decision or balance for either settlement
unresolved.reason: The letter establishes that the estimate was missing at the time of writing, not that it was still missing at the cut-off. No later estimate or settlement-specific payment decision is supplied. The absence of a decision in this packet does not establish that no decision exists elsewhere.

unresolved.issue: Ordinary finance query: EX-K4 print-shop charge (£8.40)
unresolved.reason: The expense list refers to a receipt, but Una reports that the office received neither the receipt nor a copy or substitute voucher. The underlying claim remains unverified and is not an authorised balance. Keep it separate from both distribution papers.
